customMethods.script:
'''
		eventInfo (dict)
		- scheduleBlockInfo (dict)
		- start (string): i.e '2025-01-01 06:00:00'
		- end (string): i.e '2025-01-01 14:00:00'
	'''

	log = system.util.getLogger("kanoa_operations_view")
	log.info("addEvent() called for %s to %s "%(eventInfo['start'], eventInfo['end']))
#	system.perspective.print("addEvent() called for %s to %s "%(eventInfo['start'], eventInfo['end']))

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True

	scheduleBlockInfo = eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo']

	startDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['start'])
	endDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['end'])
	timezone = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone
	scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, - system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate))
	scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, - system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, endDate))
	
	if not self.checkEventUpdate(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate']): return	#Can't edit this event

	system.kanoa.shift.addShiftBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Schedule event saved')
	self.refreshCalendarEvents({'calledBy': 'scheduleOperation'})	

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
	
	startDate = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate))
	system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftEvents({'assetPath': scheduleBlockInfo['assetPath'], 'startDate': startDate, 'forceDelete': True})

	return

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteEvents() called with changeType %s"%changeType)
	timezone = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	selectedIds = self.view.custom.calendar.selection.ids
	deletedCount = 0
	startDate = None

	for k, v in self.view.custom.schedule.data.items():
		if k not in selectedIds: continue
		
		scheduleBlock = v	
		if scheduleBlock['rruleStr'] and changeType is None:
			self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent = scheduleBlock
			system.perspective.openPopup('recurringEventOptions', 'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/recurringEventChange', {'action': 'deleteSelectedEvents'}, 'Recurring Event Change')
			return
		elif changeType == 'This event':			
			system.kanoa.shift.addShiftBlockException(scheduleBlock['shiftBlockId'], scheduleBlock['startDate'], userId)
			deletedCount += 1
		elif changeType == 'This and following events':
			rruleStr = scheduleBlock['rruleStr']
			exceptionDate = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.parse(scheduleBlock['start']), -1)
			if "UNTIL=" in rruleStr or "COUNT=" in rruleStr: rruleStr = ";".join(rruleStr.split(';')[:-1])
			rruleStr += ";UNTIL=" + system.kanoa.utilities.javaDateToPython(exceptionDate).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')			
			system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftBlockField(scheduleBlock['shiftBlockId'], 'rruleStr', rruleStr, userId)
			deletedCount += 1
		else:
			system.kanoa.shift.deleteShiftBlock(scheduleBlock['shiftBlockId'], userId)
			deletedCount += 1
		
		if startDate is None or system.date.isBefore(scheduleBlock['startDate'], startDate): startDate = scheduleBlock['startDate']
		
	self.refreshCalendarEvents({'calledBy': 'deleteEvents'})
	if deletedCount: system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', '%s Shift %s deleted'%(deletedCount, 'event' if deletedCount==0 else 'events'))
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarnToast', 'No shift events deleted')
		
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
	
	if startDate:
		startDate = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate))
		system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftEvents({'assetPath': scheduleBlock['assetPath'], 'startDate': startDate, 'forceDelete': True})	
	
	return

customMethods.name: adjustEvent
customMethods.script:
'''
		eventInfo (dict)
		- scheduleBlockInfo (dict)
		- changeType (string)
		- start (string): i.e '2025-01-01 06:00:00'
		- end (string): i.e '2025-01-01 14:00:00'
	'''

	system.perspective.print("adjustEvent() called with %s %s to %s. ChangeType %s"%(eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo']['uuid'], eventInfo['start'], eventInfo['end'], eventInfo['changeType']))

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo'])
	changeType = eventInfo['changeType']
	startDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['start'])
	endDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['end'])
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	if scheduleBlockInfo is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', "We couldn't find the dropped schedule event. we've either lost it or the calendar has created a 'ghost event'. Navigate away and then back to this screen to clear it. BIJC is working on a fix for this")
		return	

	if not self.checkEventUpdate(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate']): return	#Can't edit this event
	
	if scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] and changeType is None:
		self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent = {'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'start': eventInfo['start'], 'end': eventInfo['end']}
		system.perspective.openPopup('recurringEventOptions', view = 'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/recurringEventChange', params={'action': 'dropEvent'}, title = 'Recurring Event Change')
		self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
		return	

	timezone = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone
	newDateOffSetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate)
	scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, - newDateOffSetMins)
	scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, - system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, endDate))
	scheduleBlockId = scheduleBlockInfo['shiftBlockId']
	rruleStr = scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr']
		
	if rruleStr is None:
		system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Schedule event saved')	
		self.refreshCalendarEvents({'calledBy': 'adjustEvents'})
	else: #From this point on we have received the recurring option, so now we know what to do with the scheduleBlock
		if changeType == 'This event':
			system.kanoa.shift.addShiftBlockException(scheduleBlockInfo['shiftBlockId'], scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], userId)
			scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] = None
			system.kanoa.shift.addShiftBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, userId)
		elif changeType == 'This and following events':
			if "UNTIL=" in rruleStr or "COUNT=" in rruleStr: rruleStr = ";".join(rruleStr.split(';')[:-1])
			
			from datetime import datetime
			dt = datetime.strptime(scheduleBlockInfo['start'], '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') # Parse the string into a datetime object
			dt = dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0) # Modify the time to midnight
			rruleStr += ";UNTIL=" + dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') # Convert back to the required format
			
			system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftBlockField(scheduleBlockInfo['shiftBlockId'], 'rruleStr', rruleStr, userId)
			system.kanoa.shift.addShiftBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, userId)
		elif changeType == 'All events':
			shiftBlockOrigStartDate = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('startDate', system.kanoa.shift.getShiftBlocks({'shiftBlockId': scheduleBlockInfo['shiftBlockId']}))
			oldDateOffSetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, shiftBlockOrigStartDate)	#Could be this block was created at a different DST time.
			delta = system.date.daysBetween(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], system.date.midnight(shiftBlockOrigStartDate))
			scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], newDateOffSetMins - oldDateOffSetMins), delta)
			scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'], newDateOffSetMins - oldDateOffSetMins), delta)
			system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, userId)

		self.refreshCalendarEvents({'refreshShifts': False, 'calledBy': 'adjustEvent'})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Schedule event updated')

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False

	startDate = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate))
	system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftEvents({'assetPath': scheduleBlockInfo['assetPath'], 'startDate': startDate, 'forceDelete': True})
	
	return

		scheduleBlockInfo['uuid'] = None
	else:
		scheduleBlockInfo = dict(self.view.custom.schedule.data[id])

	scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(system.date.parse(scheduleBlockInfo['start']), - deviceUTCOffsetMins)
	scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(system.date.parse(scheduleBlockInfo['end']), - deviceUTCOffsetMins)
	
	self.view.custom.debug.selectedBlockInfo = scheduleBlockInfo

	system.perspective.openPopup("eventPopId",'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/shiftView', params={'values': scheduleBlockInfo}, title='Shift Editor', modal=True, resizable=True, draggable=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: refreshCalendarEvents
customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print("refreshCalendarEvents() called with %s"%paramsDict)
	
	assetInfo = self.view.custom.assetInfo
	if assetInfo is None: return
	
	start = self.view.custom.filter.start
	end = self.view.custom.filter.end
	self.view.custom.schedule.data = self.getScheduledEvents(assetInfo['assetPath'], start, end, assetInfo['timeZone'])

	self.setCalendarEventSelection([])
	self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent = None
	
	return

customMethods.name: getScheduledEvents
customMethods.script:
if assetPath is None: return []

	timeNow = system.date.now()
#	system.perspective.print("getScheduledEvents() called with %s %s %s %s"%(assetPath, start, end, timezone))
	
	startDate = system.date.parse(start)
	endDate = system.date.parse(end)
	
	includeInherited = self.view.custom.filter.showInherited
	includeSubAssets = self.view.custom.filter.showSubAssets	

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Getting schedule", "type": "INFO"}	

	tzOffsets = self.view.custom.timezones
	if not tzOffsets.has_key(timezone): return []	#assetInfo has mostly likely changed
	tzOffsetMins = tzOffsets[timezone]['startOffSetMins']
	rangeStart = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(startDate, tzOffsetMins), -1)
#	rangeEnd = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, 2 * tzOffsetMins)
	rangeEnd = endDate
	
	paramsDict = {'startDate': rangeStart, 'endDate': rangeEnd, 'assetPath': assetPath, 'includeInherited': includeInherited, 'includeSubAssets': includeSubAssets,'tzOffsets': tzOffsets}
	system.perspective.print('getShiftCalendarEvents() called with %s'%paramsDict)
	scheduleData = system.kanoa.shift.getShiftCalendarEvents(paramsDict)
	scheduledEvents = system.kanoa.utilities.convertListToDict(scheduleData, 'uuid')
		
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	
#	system.perspective.print("getScheduledEvents() took %s msecs"%system.date.millisBetween(timeNow, system.date.now()))
	
	return scheduledEvents

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("editRecurringEvent() called with %s"%payload)
	
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent)
	eventInfo = dict(self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent)
	eventInfo['changeType'] = payload['selectedOption']
	
	if payload['action'] == 'deleteSelectedEvents': self.deleteEvents(payload['selectedOption'])
	elif payload['action'] in ('resizeEvent', 'dropEvent') and scheduleBlockInfo: self.adjustEvent(eventInfo)

	return
